query:
SELECT
            c.secret_hash,
            ac.user_id,
            ac.scopes
        FROM
            auth_oauth2_client_authorization_codes AS ac
        INNER JOIN
            auth_oauth2_clients AS c ON ac.client_id = c.id
        WHERE
            ac.code = $1
            AND ac.client_id = $2
            AND ac.redirect_uri = $3
            AND ac.expires_at > now()
            AND ac.completed_at IS NULL
